
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(here)
library(tmap)
library(stars)
library(viridisLite)
```

```{r}
# EJ Screen
ejscreen <- sf::st_read(here::here("data", "EJSCREEN_2023_BG_StatePct_with_AS_CNMI_GU_VI.gdb")) 

# filter to California
california <- ejscreen %>%
  dplyr::filter(ST_ABBREV == "CA") 

# filter to Los Angeles County 
los_angeles <- ejscreen %>%
  dplyr::filter(CNTY_NAME %in% c("Los Angeles County"))

# Crashes dataset
crashes <- read_csv(here::here("data", "Crashes.csv")) |>  
  as_tibble() |>
  drop_na(LATITUDE) |>
  drop_na(LONGITUDE) |> 
  st_as_sf(coords = c("LONGITUDE", "LATITUDE"), crs = 3857)

# LA Redlining dataset
redlining_la <- sf::st_read(here::here("data", "mapping-inequality-los-angeles.json"))
```

```{r}
# Check CRS for each dataset
st_crs(ejscreen)
st_crs(redlining_la)
st_crs(crashes)

# Transform Redlining LA dataset into same CRS as EJScreen dataset
redlining_la <- st_transform(redlining_la, crs = st_crs(ejscreen))

# Boolen check if CRS match between 2 datasets
st_crs(ejscreen) == st_crs(redlining_la)
st_crs(ejscreen) == st_crs(crashes)
```
